projects.title: Zenko Cloudserver Demo
projects.description: A simple demo project covering how to set and run a Zenko Cloudserver locally using docker-compose. This project was used for an internal company demo while employed at Cypress and was intended to be used as a test environment replacement for S3 so we no longer needed to store test images in a live S3 bucket for local testing.
